title: Specialty Proctor for Culture and Community Proctor Coordinator for Faculty-Student Initiatives
bio: Welcome Class of 2029, congratulations! I am so excited to meet you and to learn how I can best support you! Originally from the Caribbean and New York City, I studied at the Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and Columbia University. Prior to Harvard, I worked professionally on projects in the USA, Latin America, and Asia. At Harvard, my work is at the intersection of built environments, climate, energy, and design innovation. I enjoy spending time with family and friends, reading, traveling, and anything involving science, food, and classical music. See you soon!
